_comment: JU-1 and JU-2 (NOS Design, final). The five /judging section headings keep their existing strings and become display h2s through the existing .h2 class in app/globals.css (serif token, --display-md = clamp(34px, 4.4vw, 54px), weight 300 because the size is always >= 32px, sentence case, margin 0). The pill (.eyebrow) is dropped for these five and stays only on the hero's real eyebrow. Spacing: 24px (var(--space-5)) from h2 to body, section rhythm py-24 = var(--section-y) 96px per golden .section (design_handoff_saoc/src/styles.css:134). Golden reference: pages-interior.jsx:350-415 uses .h2 with design placeholder lines which must NOT be used. Computed values below are what the deployed browser check records.
